A look inside OnSell

From listing to handover, in three steps

No agents, no guesswork — just you, the other person, and a clear record of the trade.

1

Post or browse

List what you're selling, or browse what's nearby in Calabar and Uyo — sorted by distance, not just newest.

2

Chat in real time

Agree on price, condition, and where to meet, right inside the app — before you share a phone number with a stranger.

3

Hand it over

Meet, hand over the item, and both confirm the trade. OnSell generates a digital ownership receipt for the sale.

Built for trust, not just listings

Secondhand trading only works when both sides feel safe. Two things make that possible.

Real-time chat

Every conversation happens inside OnSell, instantly. Ask questions, negotiate, and settle a meeting spot without exchanging personal numbers until you're ready to.

Ownership receipts

When a sale is confirmed by both sides, OnSell issues a digital receipt the item, the date, and who it moved from and to. It's your proof the purchase was legitimate.
